A short history of walking literature

Published 9 February 2021.

The topographical tour

Between 1780 and 1830 the dominant form was the tour: a route described mile by mile, with antiquarian notes and a fold-out map.

The ramblers' guide

From the 1890s the guidebook took over, written for readers who would repeat the walk rather than read about it from an armchair.

The landscape essay

Since the 1990s the dominant form has been the essay, where the walk is the frame and the subject is something else entirely.
